title: tfgen run report
description: The structured result tfgen generate writes to --report. CI asserts against it, so the shape is a contract: additionalProperties is false throughout, and a new field must be added here in the same change that emits it.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this generation run.

generator_version.description: tfgen build version, or "dev" for a local build.

spec_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the OpenAPI source, identifying exactly which description produced this run.

artifacts.description: One entry per generated, retired, or failed provider artifact. Null is permitted because the field carries no omitempty and a run that produced no artifacts marshals its nil slice to null; consumers must treat null and [] alike. Accepting it here rather than emitting [] keeps existing report bytes unchanged.

skipped_operations.description: Operations that produced no artifact, listed for visibility rather than as failures.

cassettes.description: One entry per example-backed cassette target. Absent unless cassette generation was requested, so a run without it is byte-identical to one from before the feature existed.

diagnostic.description: One error, warning, or informational message. A cassette diagnostic names source anchors only and never carries an example value, which may be credential material.

artifactKind.description: Terraform namespace the artifact belongs to.

name.description: Terraform artifact name without the datadog_ prefix.

path.description: File the entry concerns. Empty on a registration_retired entry, whose generated files are already gone.

orphaned_hooks.description: Hook functions declared but no longer referenced.

constructor.description: Set only on a registration_retired entry: the removed registration identifier, authoritative because the artifact name cannot be recovered once the files are gone.

runSummary.description: Convenience counts for CI assertions, one per artifact status. Unchanged by cassette generation, which reports through cassette_summary instead.

test_name.description: Generated Go test function, which doubles as the cassette basename because the replay harness derives the cassette from t.Name().

status.description: generated: the test was written. ineligible: the description could not describe a whole lifecycle, and nothing was written. There is no preserved outcome: the generator writes only its own test, and emit refuses a file it does not own.

write_action.description: What happened to the generated test file, reported apart from status so an eligible target that produced no change is distinguishable from one that rewrote its test. Mirrors the artifactEntry status vocabulary. No action describes replacing a recording: the cassette is recorded by running the test, never written by the generator.

selected_example.description: Resolved scenario name: an explicit selection, "default", a lexical fallback, or "single" when the values came from singular example fields.

cassetteSummary.description: Counts per cassette status. Separate from runSummary so cassette generation cannot change the artifact tallies CI already asserts on.
